riverfolk: A barefoot river farmer kneeling on the bank of a winding delta river at dawn, cupping glowing water in her hands as green rice shoots sprout luminously along the banks, reed boats and a small mud-brick village in the misty background.
ferrymen: A grinning ferryman poling a flat wooden ferry across a broad river at sunset, a lantern on the prow, passengers and a donkey aboard, two gold coins glinting in his raised hand.
tidecallers: A robed tidecaller standing on a sea rock with arms raised, the ocean rising in a great curling wave around her that is full of glittering fish, a fishing village on the shore behind.
salt_traders: A salt merchant rolling a barrel of glittering white salt down a wooden pier toward a moored cargo ship, gulls overhead, heaps of salt shining like snow in the harbour warehouses.
highlanders: A kilted highland warrior standing proudly on a rocky ridge with a round shield and spear, his cloak whipping in the wind, rolling hills and a stone watch cairn below.
peak_shrines: A tiny golden shrine with a glowing lantern perched on the summit of a jagged mountain above a sea of clouds, prayer flags streaming, pilgrims climbing a winding stair.
sand_walkers: A veiled desert guide walking barefoot along the crest of a great dune at sunrise, leading a line of camels, reading the curling patterns of the sand, a green oasis far below.
mirage_poets: A desert poet sitting cross-legged on a dune, a quill of light in his hand, a shimmering mirage of a lake and palace rising from his verses on the heat haze.
woodwardens: A hooded forest ranger with a longbow crouched on a massive mossy branch, collecting fallen deadwood, shafts of green light through an ancient pine forest.
jungle_sages: An old jungle sage in a canopy treehouse grinding glowing herbs in a mortar, exotic flowers and a coiled green serpent around the branches, a waterfall behind.
frontier_charter: Colonists raising the first timber palisade wall of a new frontier town on a hill at dawn, a fresh banner hoisted above, wagons and virgin lands stretching to the horizon.
tax_farmers: A plump tax collector in a fur hat counting coins at a wooden table under a tree while a line of reluctant farmers waits with chickens and sacks of grain, a guard yawning beside him.
homesteaders: A pioneer family unloading a wagon at the site of their new homestead, the father swinging an axe, the mother planting seeds, children with a lamb, a golden wheat field beginning to grow.
walled_garden: A small perfect walled city on a hill encircled by a stone wall, bursting with flowering gardens and fruit trees inside, soft golden light, the outside world grey and misty.
great_hall: A long timber great hall at night with a roaring central fire, a crowned chieftain at the head of a long feasting table raising a horn, warriors and bards feasting.
drill_sergeants: A scarred drill sergeant bellowing orders at rows of young soldiers practicing spear thrusts in a dusty training yard, dust clouds lit by the afternoon sun.
bloodied_banners: A tattered crimson battle banner, torn and stained, planted on a hill above a battlefield at sunset, crows circling, the banner still flying proudly in the wind.
shieldwall: A tight wall of overlapping round shields held by grim soldiers, arrows bouncing off in sparks, the front warrior's eyes steady above the shield rim.
war_drums: A muscular drummer beating an enormous war drum on horseback, a charging line of cavalry behind him in a cloud of dust, the drumbeat visible as rings of energy.
headhunters: A grinning bounty hunter with a crossbow over his shoulder tossing a heavy coin purse, a smoking barbarian camp in the valley behind him, wanted posters with no writing on a tree.
march_wardens: A lone armoured border warden standing watch atop a wooden tower on the frontier at dusk, a signal brazier blazing, wild dark forest stretching beyond.
bardic_college: A bard in a colourful doublet playing a lute on a stage before a cheering tavern crowd, violet music notes of light swirling upward, candles and ale mugs.
storytellers: An old storyteller by a campfire at night, his hands raised as the smoke forms glowing images of dragons, heroes and ships above the fire, children listening in awe.
star_charts: An astronomer on a rooftop at night unrolling a star chart as glowing constellations connect across the sky above, brass telescopes and an armillary sphere.
market_criers: A loud market crier standing on a crate with arms wide in a bustling bazaar, colourful awnings, baskets of figs and bolts of silk, crowds turning to listen.
coin_counters: A meticulous banker in a vaulted counting house stacking towers of gold coins by candlelight, an abacus and scales, coins gleaming like a treasure mountain.
tithe_box: An ornate carved wooden offering box on a temple altar with a single gold coin dropping into its slot in a beam of holy light, candles and a golden chalice beside it.
granary_keepers: A granary keeper standing in a vast granary of stacked grain sacks and bins overflowing with golden grain, sunbeams through the rafters, cats watching for mice.
fertile_fields: A farmer ploughing rich dark earth with two oxen, lush green crop rows glowing behind the plough, a sunlit valley of patchwork fields.
midwives: A kind midwife lifting a newborn baby toward the dawn light streaming through a cottage window, the happy mother resting, warm golden glow.
forgemasters: A burly forgemaster hauling a glowing ore cart out of a mountain mine entrance, sparks and lantern light, stone quarry terraces carved into the mountain behind.
foremen: A foreman with a measuring rod and plans shouting directions from a scaffold as workers raise a stone building, cranes of wood and rope, dust and sunlight.
master_masons: A master mason chiselling a colossal stone block for a pyramid, his mason's mark glowing on the stone, the monumental pyramid rising behind under a golden sky.
bread_and_circuses: A roaring amphitheatre crowd cheering as bread loaves are tossed into the stands, chariots racing in the arena below, confetti and theatre masks.
content_folk: Happy villagers dancing around a maypole in a sunny meadow, a smiling sun above, flowers and ribbons whirling, a thatched village behind.
patrons_seal: A noble's jewelled signet ring pressing a wax seal onto a folded blank letter, a gleaming golden key and rubies spilling from a velvet purse beside it.
open_market: A friendly merchant sweeping open the curtain of a treasure-filled stall, inviting the viewer to browse glowing wares, amulets and cards on display under lanterns.
heralds: A royal herald in a tabard blowing a long golden trumpet from the city walls, a blank unrolled proclamation in his other hand, crowds gathering below.
scribes_of_decree: A monk scribe sealing a decree with molten wax by candlelight in a scriptorium, a quill feather glowing, stacks of sealed scrolls with no visible writing.
lorekeepers: A lorekeeper in a circular library tower holding up a candle, rows of rolled scrolls glowing like candles on the shelves around her, forming a dawn of light.
stoic_chroniclers: A stoic chronicler writing in a great book by a single candle while a storm rages outside the window, his face calm, dark ink flowing like a river from the quill.

tally_stones: A wise elder placing one smooth pebble onto a tall cairn of stacked tally stones at sunrise, a long row of cairns stretching into the distance.
bonfire_of_tales: A huge roaring bonfire at night with glowing embers rising and turning into tiny figures of heroes and beasts, the fire beginning to burn low at its base.
gilders_guild: A gilder applying glittering gold leaf to a statue with a soft brush, gold flakes floating in the air, a workshop filled with golden gilded objects.
nest_egg: A wise owl perched protectively on a nest holding a single glowing golden egg, in the hollow of an old oak tree, moonlight.
vanguard: A lone armoured knight bursting first through a smashed castle gate on a charging horse, sword raised, a golden eagle banner behind him.
rearguard: A tall shield-bearer walking backward through a gate, holding a great shield against pursuing shadows as the gate closes behind the retreating army.
road_wardens: A scout on horseback beside a stone milestone on a hilltop road, spyglass raised to his eye, a road winding across the countryside to distant cities.
pathfinders: An explorer with a staff and backpack stepping off the edge of a map into an unexplored glowing wilderness, the parchment curling away at her feet.
muses_favor: A graceful muse in violet robes playing a golden lyre atop marble steps, notes of light spiralling into the air, an artist's easel and sculptures glowing.
lamplighters: A lamplighter on a ladder lighting a street lamp at dusk, glowing flasks of blue light hanging from the lamps along a street of scholars' windows.

war_banner: A massive red war banner with a golden sword emblem raised high by a warrior on a hilltop, the army cheering beneath it, wind snapping the cloth.
harvest_moon: A huge glowing golden harvest moon rising over fields of ripe wheat sheaves, farmers carrying bundles home, fireflies in the dusk.
triumphal_arch: A monumental triumphal arch of white marble decorated with laurel carvings, a victorious general's chariot passing beneath it, petals raining down.
legend_of_the_steppe: A lone steppe horse archer on a rearing horse atop a hill, silhouetted against a gigantic crimson sun, the endless grass sea rippling below.
river_kings: A crowned river king standing on the prow of a gilded royal barge on a great river, trade boats paying tribute around him, a river city behind.

dune_riders: Desert riders on galloping horses sweeping down a towering dune in a spray of golden sand, curved blades flashing, the sun blazing behind them.
sacred_grove: A sacred grove of enormous ancient trees whose trunks form a natural cathedral, glowing green light filtering through the canopy, druids at a stone altar.
wide_horizons: A cartographer standing on a high cliff looking out over an endless sunlit land dotted with many cities, rivers and roads to the horizon, a sun rising.

philosopher_kings: A bearded philosopher-king in a white toga sitting on a marble throne reading a scroll, an owl on his shoulder, a small perfect city visible through the columns.

veterans_pride: A proud veteran warrior in gleaming unscratched lion-crested armour roaring as he charges, a golden lion spirit leaping alongside him.
conquerors_spoils: A conqueror in crimson armour standing in a captured treasury piled with gold, crowns and jewels, a toppled enemy banner under his boot.
bounty_board: A rough wooden bounty board in a frontier town square with blank wanted posters nailed to it, adventurers crowding around, a bag of silver hanging from a nail.
patron_of_the_arts: A noble patron in a theatre box raising a golden mask, a painter, a sculptor and dancers performing below him, magenta curtains.
grand_academy: Students in a grand domed academy lecture hall watching a professor demonstrate a glowing experiment with sparks of blue light, chalkboards filled only with diagrams.
eureka_cycle: An inventor leaping out of an overflowing bathtub with a shout, a lightning bolt of inspiration flashing above his head, blueprints of machines flying.

merchant_princes: A merchant prince in silk and pearls reclining on cushions surrounded by chests of spices, silks and pearls, a golden chalice in his hand, ships in the bay.
harvest_festival: Villagers dancing around a bonfire on a harvested field at dusk, barns overflowing with grain, garlands of wheat and fiddlers playing.
cornucopia: An enormous golden horn of plenty spilling fruit, grain and tools onto a table, the tools turning into glowing hammers.

jubilee: Joyful crowds celebrating in a festive city square, bells ringing in every tower, wine flowing from a fountain, laurel garlands and petals in the air.
black_market: A hooded dealer in a dark alley opening a cloak lined with glowing contraband cards and trinkets, lanterns casting magenta light, a masked buyer watching.

edict_hoard: An ornate writing desk with a secret drawer open revealing neatly stacked rolled decrees tied with ribbons and wax seals, candlelight glinting.
arcane_recycler: A mage holding a spent scroll that is dissolving into glowing ink which flows in a serpentine spiral into a new rolled scroll, violet magic.
focus_lens: A large brass-framed crystal lens focusing a beam of sunlight into a single blazing point that sets a parchment aflame, a scholar watching.
pillar_harmony: Six glowing marble pillars of different colours supporting a single golden temple roof, light radiating from their harmony, clouds around.
crisis_forged: A blacksmith hammering a glowing sword on an anvil in the middle of a raging storm, lightning striking the blade and tempering it.
doomsayers: A wild-eyed doomsayer on a city street holding a staff with a glowing eye totem, pointing to a burning red sky while the crowd looks up in fear.
blood_price: A jewelled golden chalice overflowing with glowing crimson wine on a dark altar, a crowned shadow reaching for it, rose petals falling.
aeon_clock: A colossal ornate clock tower with an hourglass heart, the gears of the ages turning, empires rising and falling reflected in its glowing face.
glory_hunters: Adventurers climbing the steep steps of a colossal golden pyramid toward the gods' light shining at the summit.
relic_hunters: An explorer with a lantern discovering a gigantic ancient stone arch in a hidden valley, a waterfall and glowing crystals, map and compass in hand.
citizen_militia: Townsfolk defending their city walls with a mix of pikes, crossbows and frying pans, a baker and a poet among them, determined faces.
silk_roads: A caravan of camels laden with bright bolts of silk crossing a mountain pass, the silk streaming in the wind like ribbons connecting two distant cities.
conscripts: A line of young village conscripts receiving spears and helmets from a quartermaster's wagon, mothers watching, a recruiting banner above.
pilgrimage: A long line of pilgrims with walking staffs and lanterns walking a winding mountain road toward a glowing temple at the summit at dawn.
council_seat: A grand circular council chamber with carved chairs around a round table, one empty high-backed chair illuminated by a beam of light, a crown resting on it.
echo: A heroic figure shouting from a mountain top, the shout rippling outward as glowing echoes that form a second identical translucent figure beside him.
keystone: An arch of glowing stones with a single golden keystone being set into place at its apex by a mason's hands, the whole arch lighting up.
iron_oath: Two armoured hands clasping over a blazing anvil, sealing an unbreakable oath in sparks, a sword laid across the anvil.
collectors_cabinet: A collector's glass cabinet filled with rare gilded, glowing and prismatic artefacts, a monocled collector admiring a shining gem.
warlords_crown: A heavy spiked iron and gold crown resting on a pile of captured city keys and banners, a warlord's gauntleted hand reaching for it, fire behind.

momentum: A golden eagle diving at incredible speed with a trail of light, sweeping over a victorious army that follows its path across the plain.
river_of_gold: A river that shines molten gold winding through a green valley past a capital city, fishermen pulling up nets full of gold coins.
sky_citadels: A soaring citadel built on a craggy hilltop above the clouds, eagles circling its towers, a winding road climbing to its gates.
desert_bloom: A desert suddenly carpeted with blooming flowers after a rare rain, a single wanderer amazed, dunes turning pink and gold with petals under a warm sun.
elder_canopy: Colossal elder trees with trunks as wide as towers, a tiny traveller walking beneath the vast canopy, glowing spores and dappled green light.
alchemy: An alchemist in a cluttered laboratory transmuting a lead ingot into gleaming gold in a glowing crucible, bubbling flasks and swirling vapours.
imperial_mandate: A crowned emperor receiving a beam of golden sunlight from the heavens on a mountaintop altar, a radiant sun disc descending above his head.
marshals_baton: A field marshal pointing a gilded baton toward the horizon from a hilltop while columns of soldiers stream forward in the direction it points, eagle standards.
edifice_complex: An impossibly crowded city skyline of towers, domes, spires and monuments all built on top of each other reaching into the sky, a proud builder in front.
campfire_tales: Old warriors around a campfire under the stars, ghostly spirits of fallen heroes rising from the flames to listen, sparks drifting.
harbinger: A black-robed harbinger with a skull mask standing on a clifftop raising a lantern toward a darkening crimson sky full of falling stars.
glass_crown: A dazzling crown made entirely of crystal glass on a velvet cushion refracting blinding rainbow light, a hairline crack beginning to form.
banner_of_ascendancy: A great golden lion banner planted on a conquered fortress, radiating light as the defeated enemy banners fall around it.
dynasty: A gallery of royal portrait silhouettes and a family tree of glowing branches, a lion crest at its root, a young heir holding the ancestral sword.
scholars_quill: A magnificent white feather quill writing on its own in the air, leaving a trail of shimmering blue light forming a spiral of knowledge.
silver_tongue: A smiling diplomat in fine robes whispering into the ear of a delighted king, silver light flowing from his lips like ribbons.
mirror_court: A grand hall of mirrors reflecting a single king into a thousand crowned reflections, each glowing brighter, crystal chandeliers.
eternal_emperor: An ageless emperor on a colossal throne wearing a towering stack of many crowns, cities burning and bowing in the distance, crimson and gold.
golden_sovereign: A radiant golden queen standing above her glowing cities like a sun, each city shining like a jewel in her crown.
undying_architect: A wizened ancient architect with a long white beard and compass, surrounded by a spiral of cities built across the ages, ghostly scaffolds.
the_unbowed: A warrior standing unbroken with a great shield raised above his head while the sky itself cracks and falls in burning fragments around him.
the_archivist: An endless archive of shelves stretching into infinity, a meticulous archivist floating on a ladder filing duplicate sealed scrolls, lanterns glowing.
architect_of_ages: A godlike architect figure of golden light placing wonders like chess pieces on a vast landscape, a great pyramid and colossus below.
apotheosis: A hero ascending into the heavens in a pillar of golden light, the figures of past heroes rising with him, the sky opening in a blazing golden sunburst.
solar_dynasty: A golden sun-disc throne on a stepped pyramid at dawn, the first rays of the sun igniting a crowned queen seated upon it, golden wonder rising behind.
tidal_charter: A charter sealed on the deck of a rolling ship, a captain pressing a wax seal of a wave emblem onto a blank parchment as spray flies, coastal city behind.
hoofbeat_saga: A singing rider galloping at the head of a charge, the song visible as streams of glowing light around the horses, a crimson sunset battlefield.
heartwood_rites: Forest druids holding hands in a circle around a massive glowing heartwood tree, its roots pulsing with green light, fireflies swirling.
caravan_of_stars: A desert caravan travelling at night beneath a glittering sky, following a trail of brilliant stars that form a road across the heavens.
infinite_codex: An infinite book whose pages unfold into a spiral staircase of paper, a scholar climbing it toward glowing stars, violet light.
anvil_oath: A smith's hammer striking an anvil with a blue-white spark forming a glowing gear emblem that hangs in the air, a mountain forge behind.
veil_of_fate: A shimmering translucent veil embroidered with stars parting to reveal a glimpse of a glowing future city, a veiled oracle holding its edge.
